name: ISL Sign Language Production Literature Review Evaluation
description: Evaluation topics for a research-copilot literature-review pipeline. Must-cite papers are retrieval/coverage anchors, not an exhaustive gold bibliography.

topics.question: Compare neural architectures for text-to-sign language production, including text-to-pose pipelines, discrete motion-token generation, and multilingual 3D avatar generation. Explain the main design choices, evidence, and limitations.

must_cite.title: Signs as Tokens: A Retrieval-Enhanced Multilingual Sign Language Generator
A Data-Driven Representation for Sign Language Production
Text2Sign: Towards Sign Language Production Using Neural Machine Translation and Generative Adversarial Networks

topics.question: Review discrete representations for sign-language pose generation, focusing on VQ-VAE or Pose-VQVAE tokenization, codebook design, autoregressive generation, and discrete diffusion. Compare reconstruction and generation trade-offs.

must_cite.title: G2P-DDM: Generating Sign Pose Sequence from Gloss Sequence with Discrete Diffusion Model
Signs as Tokens: A Retrieval-Enhanced Multilingual Sign Language Generator
A Data-Driven Representation for Sign Language Production

topics.question: Assess the available Indian Sign Language datasets and benchmarks for sign-language processing and text-to-pose research. Compare task coverage, annotation types, scale, splits, and the limitations these resources create for sign-language production.

must_cite.title: iSign: A Benchmark for Indian Sign Language Processing
ISLTranslate: Dataset for Translating Indian Sign Language

topics.question: How should sign-language production systems be evaluated beyond training loss? Review pose reconstruction and alignment metrics, back-translation or gloss-based metrics, token prediction accuracy, temporal consistency, and human evaluation. State what each metric captures and what it can miss.

must_cite.title: Signs as Tokens: A Retrieval-Enhanced Multilingual Sign Language Generator
G2P-DDM: Generating Sign Pose Sequence from Gloss Sequence with Discrete Diffusion Model
A Data-Driven Representation for Sign Language Production

topics.question: What methods and data resources are relevant to building sign-language production systems for low-resource languages such as Indian Sign Language? Discuss dataset scarcity, transfer from other sign languages, pose-based representations, and evidence-supported limitations without assuming that results transfer directly to ISL.

must_cite.title: iSign: A Benchmark for Indian Sign Language Processing
ISLTranslate: Dataset for Translating Indian Sign Language
A Gloss-driven Indian Sign Language Production System Using Learned Pose Representations

topics.question: Review challenges in generalizing text-to-sign production to unseen sentences and producing coherent continuous motion. Cover compositionality, sign co-articulation, body-hand coordination, motion naturalness, and the strengths and weaknesses of available quantitative and qualitative evaluation protocols.

must_cite.title: Signs as Tokens: A Retrieval-Enhanced Multilingual Sign Language Generator
A Data-Driven Representation for Sign Language Production
Text2Sign: Towards Sign Language Production Using Neural Machine Translation and Generative Adversarial Networks
